name: Pink World 3
summary:
Overview:
You play from the main character's POV. An accountant who's been tasked to work an all night shift to meet a deadline with your co-workers. However after the sky turned pink inexplicably, the ''growing'' tasks suddenly doesn't feel so bad!
With a whopping 5 female characters to get bimbofied, each of them with two different outcomes depending on your choices!​
